title: Career Change

expressions.example: He worked hard to climb the corporate ladder.
A lot of employees jumped ship last year.
Don't burn bridges when you resign.
She decided to take the leap and start her own business.

sentences: I used to work in a big office.
I would commute two hours every day.
She used to hate her old job.
We would always complain about the traffic.
He used to be a teacher before becoming a freelancer.
They didn't use to work remotely.
Did you use to work in finance?
I would never imagine becoming my own boss.

grammar.title: Used To + Would — Hábitos Passados
rules: "Used to" descreve hábitos ou estados no passado que não existem mais: I used to work in a big office.
"Would" também descreve hábitos passados repetidos, mas só com ações (não estados): I would commute two hours every day.
Negativa e pergunta usam "did(n't) use to": Did you use to work in finance?
